name: jev-skill-router
description: Automatically route Codex skill selection through TypeSafe Jev on each user prompt.

interface.shortDescription: Let Jev select relevant skills before each turn.
interface.longDescription: A UserPromptSubmit hook that evaluates enabled skills with TypeSafe Jev and supplies the selected skill paths to Codex. Explicit skill requests and existing permissions remain authoritative.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me configure Jev Skill Router.
